title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds $64,562 after a flat US close, up just 0.5% despite extreme fear at 25 on the index. Network strength stands out with hashrate at 899 EH/s and a loaded mempool of 90,914 transactions carrying a 2 sat/vB floor fee. 

Key takeaway: price action ignores sentiment while fundamentals grind higher. Block 961,234 confirms steady throughput. 

Overnight watch: any break below 64k could trigger quick stops into Asia, while sustained low fees may signal building demand.
